maximum temperatures in refrigerated display cabinets are generally in the most ambient exposed areas and minimum temperatures are in the least exposed locations.

the temperature distribution in refrigerated cabinets is not uniform and that the temperature of a given pack is dependent on its position in the cabinet and that the position of maximum temperatures is generally at the most exposed (ambient) areas and minimum temperatures at the least exposed areas of the cabinet.
